g.text: Graph revision AD - a_col01: Internals stack (A-COL, all solids): perforated support plate (50 % open envelope), random ring bed, drip-pipe distributor, mesh demister
Graph revision AD - a_col01: Packing: 25 mm PVC-U Pall rings, in-house cut tube rings (X-MFG-32 class), bed 3000 mm
Graph revision AD - a_col01: The ring bed draws as its envelope at the bulk class; the rings are made on the jellybean line (BOM item 3)
Graph revision AD - a_col01: Duty section 2 rule: no sump volume is invented from the gas mass - the sump is the house class and is reported, not used (A-VES rule)
